node.title: Post-quadratic MDS extension fence
node.statement: For RS[F_5,{0,1,2,3},2] at radius r=1, the first radius beyond the quadratic hypothesis, a column-far received pair with syndromes y_0=(0,1), y_1=(1,4) has four CA-bad finite slopes, while r+1=2. Thus the official post-quadratic CA assertion cannot follow from a universal MDS extension of B_ca^far(n-r)<=r+1; an official-row proof must exploit additional long-domain or anchor-pencil structure.
